# 11751: Media Message - Media exceeds messaging provider size limit

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 11751

[error-11751 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/11751#error-11751)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE SMS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/11751#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

## Error - 11751

[error---11751 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/11751#error---11751)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Media Message -> Media exceeds messaging provider size limit

[media-message---media-exceeds-messaging-provider-size-limit page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/11751#media-message---media-exceeds-messaging-provider-size-limit)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Maximum size limit depends on the messaging channel.

- For an MMS message, the size limit is [5MB](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/accepted-mime-types "5MB").
- For a WhatsApp message, the size limit is [16MB](https://www.twilio.com/docs/whatsapp/guidance-whatsapp-media-messages "16MB").

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/11751#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The total size of the media message request exceeds the maximum size limit for the channel.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/11751#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

If you are sending multiple media files on a message, split them into multiple requests to reduce the size of each request.

# 12300: Invalid Content-Type

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 12300

[error-12300 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/12300#error-12300)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/12300#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio is unable to process the Content-Type of the provided URL. Please see Twilio's [documentation on accepted content types](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/twiml#twilio-understands-mime-types "documentation on accepted content types ") for more information on valid Content-Types.

You must return a Content-Type for all requests. Requests without a Content-Type will appear in the [Debugger](https://www.twilio.com/console/runtime/debugger "Debugger") as a 502 Bad Gateway error.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/12300#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Having a phone number, outgoing call request or action attribute refer to a non-XML or audio resource.
- Having a Play verb attempt to play non-audio content, such as XML or text.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/12300#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Verify that that your web server is returning a Content-Type and it is the expected value
- Make sure the URL noted refers to a valid resource
- Make sure messages to or from your Twilio phone number are using a supported content-type. See the [full list of supported content types](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/accepted-mime-types "full list of supported content types").
- Use one of the [supported request types](https://www.twilio.com/docs/runtime/functions/request-flow#supported-requests "supported request types") to call a Twilio function.

# 13214: Dial: Invalid callerId value

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## WARNING: 13214

[warning-13214 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13214#warning-13214)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

WARNING

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13214#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

## Warning - 13214

[warning---13214 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13214#warning---13214)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Dial: Invalid callerId value

[dial-invalid-callerid-value page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13214#dial-invalid-callerid-value)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

callerId must be the calling number, called number, or a validated outgoing number. Additionally, if the calling leg is a client leg, the caller ID is required and must be a validated outgoing number. See the [Dial Verb](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/twiml/dial#callerId "Dial Verb") API Reference for more information.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13214#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Carriers may send invalid Caller IDs on Incoming calls to Twilio. If a specific Caller ID is not explicitly defined on the verb, the invalid Caller ID will be passed to the destination. This may cause some destination providers to reject the call, and Twilio will mark it as failed.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13214#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

To work around this, your application should recognize invalid caller IDs, and substitute them with a valid Caller ID to construct the subsequent .

# 13222: Dial->Number: Invalid sendDigits value

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## WARNING: 13222

[warning-13222 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13222#warning-13222)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

WARNING

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13222#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The `sendDigits` attribute may contain numbers, the `#` and `*` characters, the letters `A`, `B`, `C`, `D`, as well as lowercase `w` to "wait" for half a second or uppercase `W` to "wait" for a full second. See the [Dial Verb](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/twiml/dial "Dial Verb") API Reference for more information.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13222#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The attribute `sendDigits` includes an invalid character.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13222#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Ensure the `sendDigits` attribute only contains the characters: `0123456789ABCD*#wW`.

Phone Numbers must be in E.164 format. E.164 numbers are formatted \[+\] \[country code\] \[subscriber number including area code\] and can have a maximum of 15 digits.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13223#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- The phone number you are attempting to dial is not in E.164 format
- The `<Number>` noun inside your `<Dial>` TwiML instructions is not present
- You are attempting to dial something that is not a phone number

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13223#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Check the format of the phone number inside your `<Dial><Number>` TwiML.

Verify that the number is in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format"):

- Includes the country code
- Includes the area code
- Does not exceed 15 digits
- Does not include any invalid characters, like hyphens or parentheses

In your TwiML instructions, the phone number must be between the opening and closing `<Number>` tags, which are nested within `<Dial>`'s opening and closing tags:

Copy code block

```

```

If you are attempting to `<Dial>` an SDK end-user, ensure you're using the `<Client>` noun inside your `<Dial>` tags.

If you are attempting to `<Dial>` a SIP endpoint, ensure you're using the `<Sip>` noun inside your `<Dial>` tags.

For more information, read the [`<Dial>` docs](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/twiml/dial).

# 13224: Dial: Twilio does not support calling this number or the number is invalid

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 13224

[error-13224 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13224#error-13224)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13224#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio does not support calling this number or the number is invalid

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13224#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

This error occurs when the provided number is not in E.164 format; for example using local dialing pattern 01234567890 instead of the full E.164 address +441234567890. This can also occur when calls are attempted to non-existent country codes, area codes, or exchanges. For example, there is no +693 country code, no +1238 US area code, and no 555 US exchange.

This can also occur with properly-formatted, valid destinations if none of Twilio's carrier partners are able to deliver the call; for example due to a telecom network outage in the phone number's local area.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13224#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Use E.164 formatting and ensure the destination is a valid, in-service destination.

# 13225: Dial: Call blocked by Twilio

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 13225

[error-13225 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13225#error-13225)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13225#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The destination number is blocked by Twilio.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13225#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The outbound call to the destination number was blocked by Twilio. Potential causes may be:

- The destination has a high-risk of fraud
- Due to regulatory reasons, the destination cannot be reached
- You are placing a call to a +1 destination and your account is missing a Primary Customer Profile

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13225#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Potential solutions may be:

- If your destination is being incorrectly identified as high-risk of fraud and you have a legitimate need to call this number, please reach out to Twilio Support through the [Console(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/ "Console") or [Help Center(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us "Help Center").
- If you are placing a call to a +1 destination and your account is missing a Primary Customer Profile, create one in [TrustHub(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/trust-hub/customer-profiles "TrustHub").

# 13238: Dial->Conference: Invalid Verb used in waitUrl, holdUrl, or announceUrl TwiML

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 13238

[error-13238 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13238#error-13238)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13238#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The TwiML that executes via the waitUrl, holdUrl, or announceUrl can only contain Say, Play, Pause, and Redirect verbs. Dial, Gather, Hangup and Record are not allowed.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13238#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Dial, Gather, Hangup or Record verbs are used in the TwiML.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13238#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Remove Dial, Gather, Hangup and Record verbs from the TwiML.

# 13247: Dial: Invalid From number (caller ID)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 13247

[error-13247 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13247#error-13247)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13247#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to initiate an outbound phone call or message, but the `From` parameter you supplied was not a valid phone number or alphanumeric sender ID.

Twilio accepts phone numbers in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format") (i.e. "+1 format"), 10-digit US and Canadian numbers with any combination of non-digit separators, or Alphanumeric Sender IDs (SMS only) with up to 11 alphanumeric characters \[a-zA-Z0-9\]. Refer to [this page(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223133867-Using-Alphanumeric-Sender-ID-with-Messaging-Services "this page") for acceptable characters.

The number must not be on a do-not-originate (DNO) list, and Alpha Sender IDs may not be generic.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13247#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- You have supplied a phone number that was not in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format")
- Your `From` phone number is on a do-not-originate (DNO) list

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13247#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure your number is formatted in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format")
- Ensure that your `From` number is assigned and not on a do-not-originate (DNO) list.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Gather->Play: Invalid Content-Type

[gather-play-invalid-content-type page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13325#gather-play-invalid-content-type)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Play requires an audio Content-Type

#### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13325#possible-causes)

- Play references a URL that does not return audio or is returning an invalid Content-Type.

#### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13325#possible-solutions)

- Make certain the URL returns an audio file
- See the [Play Verb](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/twiml/play "Play Verb") API Reference for more information on valid Content-Types.

# 13430: Play: Invalid DTMF String

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## WARNING: 13430

[warning-13430 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13430#warning-13430)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

WARNING

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13430#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The `digit` attribute may contain numbers, the `#` and `*` characters, the letters `A`, `B`, `C`, `D`, as well as lowercase `w` to "wait" for half a second or uppercase `W` to "wait" for a full second.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13430#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The attribute `digit` includes an invalid character.

### Possible Solutions

# 13521: \`<Say>\` element character limits exceeded

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## WARNING: 13521

[warning-13521 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13521#warning-13521)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

WARNING

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13521#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The maximum text length inside a verb is limited and varies depending on the option used. Basic, Polly and Google TTS have different limits and character count.

See the [Say Verb](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/twiml/say#voice "Say Verb") API Reference for more information.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13521#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The maximum text length inside the `<Say>` verb has been exceeded.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13521#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Make sure that the character limit is under the limit for the TTS type being used:

- Basic TTS Voices are limited to 4096 UTF-8 single byte characters
- Polly TTS Voices are limited to 3000 UTF-8 single byte characters; note that SSML tags do not contribute to the character count
- Google TTS Voices are limited to 5000 UTF-8 single byte characters; note that SSML tags, newlines and spaces contribute to the character count
- The URL-encoded string cannot exceed 4500 characters

# 13617: Record: Recording length is out of range for transcription

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## WARNING: 13617

[warning-13617 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13617#warning-13617)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

WARNING

* * *

## Warning - 13617

[warning---13617 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13617#warning---13617)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Record: Recording length is out of range for transcription

[record-recording-length-is-out-of-range-for-transcription page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13617#record-recording-length-is-out-of-range-for-transcription)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio could not process the transcription because the duration of the recording is either too short or too long. The recording itself will not be affected.

#### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13617#possible-solutions)

- Transcription is currently limited to recordings with a duration greater than 2 seconds and less than 120 seconds. Consider using the maxLength parameter for `<Record>` to limit the duration of the recording. See [transcription TwiML reference](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/twiml/record#attributes-transcribe "transcription TwiML reference") for more information.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Record: Recording not available for transcription

[record-recording-not-available-for-transcription page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13618#record-recording-not-available-for-transcription)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

#### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13618#possible-causes)

- The recording was deleted before before Twilio was able to fetch the recording for transcription.

#### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13618#possible-solutions)

- Make a request to delete the recording once you receive the transcribe callback instead of the record callback. This ensures that the recording is available for Twilio to transcribe and still allows you to delete recordings from Twilio.

# 13801: Refer not allowed on non-SIP call legs

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 13801

[error-13801 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13801#error-13801)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13801#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The Refer verb is only allowed on SIP call legs, e.g. you can refer an incoming SIP call that originate from SIP infrastructure or an outbound call to a SIP destination. Calls to or from other destinations, such as a phone number or Twilio Client cannot be referred.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13801#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Your application attempted to invoke the Refer verb on a PSTN or Twilio Client call leg.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13801#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- For more information on understanding what does and does not constitute a SIP call leg, please see [Understanding SIP Call Legs](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/twiml/refer#understanding-call-legs "Understanding SIP Call Legs").
- While invoking Refer on a SIP leg is unique in that it removes Twilio from the call path, the effect of transferring a call to another party can be accomplished on all leg types by simply using the Dial verb to call the other party.

# 13802: Dial: No referUrl attribute specified

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 13802

[error-13802 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13802#error-13802)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13802#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

In order to send a SIP REFER message to an established `<Dial>` call, the `referUrl` attribute must be specified in the TwiML. In this case, a REFER was received on a `<Dial>` call without a `referUrl` attribute present.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13802#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Your `<Dial>` verb did not include a `referUrl` attribute or the attribute was misspelled

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13802#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Add a valid `referUrl` attribute to your `<Dial>` verb
- For more information on sending REFER to Twilio, see [Refer to Twilio](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/refer-to-twilio "Refer to Twilio")

# 13807: Client Notification URL Error Response

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 13807

[error-13807 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13807#error-13807)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13807#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The Client Notification URL returned an error.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13807#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Your URL is returning 5xx error due to an internal server issue
- Your URL is returning a 400, 401, or 403 due to a server misconfiguration or authentication/authorization issue
- Your URL returned a 404 due to a misconfiguration of your `clientNotificationUrl` in your TwiML or API request
- Your URL returned a 404 because your application could not find a binding for the user receiving the call

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/13807#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Resolve your server errors
- Reconfigure your `clientNotificationUrl` to the correct URL
- Remove the user who has no binding from your call routing
- Return a 200 OK
- Verify you are using [Client Call Notification Webhook](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/sdks/call-notification-webhook "Client Call Notification Webhook") correctly

[to-attribute-is-invalid page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14101#to-attribute-is-invalid)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

# 14107: SMS send rate limit exceeded

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 14107

[error-14107 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14107#error-14107)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE SMS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14107#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Too many messages have been sent between two numbers within a short time period, possibly indicating a runaway job or infinite loop. There is a limit of 30 outbound replies between two phone numbers in a 30-second period.

A counter is set for each outbound reply in a conversation (between two numbers). When the first reply occurs, the counter starts at 1. If the next reply is sent less than 30 seconds after the prior reply, then the counter goes to 2. This will continue if each reply is less than 30 seconds, until the counter surpasses 30; at this time, Twilio will set any further messages in the loop to "failed" status for 30 seconds, with this error code.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14107#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- repeated rapid responses by the end user (30 replies in less than 30 seconds)
- infinite loop caused by self referencing Sms or Message verb action URL
- infinite loop caused by self referencing Redirect verb URL
- runaway process making repeated outgoing REST API requests

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14107#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- make certain any action or Redirect URL's do not loop back to the same TwiML document.
- make sure you are not inadvertently sending a large quantity of messages to the same phone number, e.g. a script caught in a loop
- if you need this protection disabled for your Twilio Account, [contact Twilio Support(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/console/support/tickets/create "contact Twilio Support"). Please note, if you choose to have this feature disabled, you must have protection in place in your application to prevent costly auto-reply loops.

# 14207: Enqueue: The targeted queue reached max queue size

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## WARNING: 14207

[warning-14207 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14207#warning-14207)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

WARNING

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14207#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The targeted queue has reached its maxSize limit. Once the queue reaches the limit, new requests to queue calls using will be rejected.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14207#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

A full queue can indicate higher volume, longer queue times, or an incorrectly configured queue's maxSize.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14207#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

A queue's maxSize can be adjusted to a maximum of 5000. Use the [Queue API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/queue-resource "Queue API") to identify the current maxSize and adjust accordingly.

If a waitUrl is provided for , the parameters MaxQueueSize and CurrentQueueSize are included in the Webhook request to the waitUrl. Your application can use this information to determine queue capacity and adjust max queue size via the [API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/queue-resource "API").

If the queue is already configured for the maximum allowed queue size (5000), one possible workaround is to create multiple queues and distribute the requests between them.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

TASKROUTER

WARNING

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14241#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Starting Nov. 30, 2021 we will no longer return data older than 30 days, and instead return a 400-response for requests with <start\_date> older than 30 days.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14241#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

<start\_date> is older than 30 days.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/14241#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Pass a <start\_date> that is within 30 days.

# 16023: Dial->Conference: Invalid participant label, must not exceed 128 characters, must not be a CallSid, must not contain '/'

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 16023

[error-16023 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16023#error-16023)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16023#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The participant label specified in an API call to create a voice conference participant was invalid. It may not exceed 128 characters, it may not be a CallSid, and it may not contain a '/' (even in URL encoded form %2F).

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16023#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

A POST to conference participants call to the Twilio API specified a participant label which is greater than 128 characters or which resembles a CallSid ("CA" followed by 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters), or contains the '/' character or URL encoded '/' character (%2F).

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16023#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Shorten the length of the ParticipantLabel parameter, avoid using a call SID and avoid including '/' characters.

# 16025: Dial->Conference: Participant label is in use by another participant

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 16025

[error-16025 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16025#error-16025)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16025#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The participant label specified as an attribute on the conference noun in twiml is already in use by another active participant in the same conference.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16025#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

1. The same static twiml specifying a participant label was served to two difference calls
2. Dynamically generated twiml specified the same participant label for two different calls
3. The participant label specified in the twiml Is the same as one specified for an outbound participant that was already added to the conference using the Twilio API

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16025#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Use a label value which uniquely identifies this participant within the conference

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 16110

[error-16110 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16110#error-16110)

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16110#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Despite our best efforts, we have failed to delete some or all of the selected recordings. The operation has been cancelled.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16110#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

There was an internal failure when processing your request. This action will not be retried.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16110#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Please retry the delete operation with the same parameters.
- If the error persists, please [contact us](https://www.twilio.com/help/contact "contact us") to figure out what has happened and how to fix it!
- Note the time of the error and which filter was used to select the recordings.

# 16111: Voice Recording: Upload file to external AWS S3 bucket failed (Invalid Configuration)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 16111

[error-16111 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16111#error-16111)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16111#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio failed to upload the recording file to the external AWS S3 bucket specified in Voice Settings due to an invalid configuration. The recording file has been deleted, and if the resource exists, the resource has been marked as "failed".

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16111#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Invalid S3 bucket URL
- Invalid AWS S3 bucket credentials
- AWS S3 bucket credentials not found in Credential Storage

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16111#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure AWS S3 bucket credentials are valid and available in Credential Storage
- Set a valid S3 bucket URL
- Disable external storage
- Ensure External Storage settings are provided for each home region you want to use

# 16112: Voice Recording: Upload file to external AWS S3 bucket failed (Access Denied)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 16112

[error-16112 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16112#error-16112)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16112#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio failed to upload the recording file to the external AWS S3 bucket specified in Voice Settings due to access denied. The recording file has been deleted, and the resource has been marked as "failed".

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16112#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- AWS credentials does not have enough permissions to upload to the bucket
- The external S3 bucket has SSE-S3 enabled, only SSE-KMS is supported

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/16112#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure AWS S3 bucket credentials are valid and have enough permission to access
- If SSE-S3 is enabled, please consider switching to SSE-KMS
- Disable external storage

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

# 17000: Forbidden to access data

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 17000

[error-17000 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17000#error-17000)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17000#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

This error code is returned when an account is trying to access a resource created by another account. Note: parent accounts can access subaccount resources, but subaccounts cannot access parent account resources, or other subaccounts under the same parent account.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17000#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

This error code is also returned when an account is attempting to access a resource where Voice Insights Advanced Features has not been enabled on that account.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17000#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Once enabled future calls will be retrievable via API.

# 17001: Completed summary for this call wasn't found

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 17001

[error-17001 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17001#error-17001)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17001#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

This error code is returned by the /Summary API when a completed summary is requested and it doesn't exist.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17001#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The call SID for the call is valid, but the call summarization process was not complete at the time of the request. Summarization takes 30 minutes to complete.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17001#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

To see results immediately, use the ProcessingState=partial query parameter, which will return a 200, but the response will contain only a partial or incomplete information until the summarization is completed.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

# 17400: Invalid query parameter

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 17400

[error-17400 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17400#error-17400)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE VOICE

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17400#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Invalid query parameter has been passed in the request.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17400#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Invalid format for country code, SIP URI, Client address, or phone number. Wildcard searches.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/17400#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Utilize only two-character country code; e.g. US Do not attempt wildcard searches; e.g. from=+1206\* Use E.164 address format for telephone numbers; e.g. +14258675309 Use SIP URI format; e.g. sip:user@domain.com Use Client address format; e.g. client:username

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PHONE NUMBERS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18004#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The supporting document you submitted had redactions or covered information that is required for the regulatory requirement.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18004#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Uploading a document with obscured or redacted information.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18004#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Re-upload the Supporting Document without any redactions or covered portions. For any ID document, make sure to provide a color copy of the ID document without any reductions. Make sure that all the edges of the ID document and MRZ data for passports are visible.

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18021#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The individual's name on the Proof of Address document does not match the information entered in the Bundle.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18021#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18021#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

# 18609: Ineligible Business Registration Authority

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 18609

[error-18609 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18609#error-18609)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PHONE NUMBERS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18609#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The provided business registration authority is not an EIN (Employer Identification Number) or DUN (Data Universal Numbering System) number.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18609#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The submitted business registration authority does not meet the eligibility requirements for the US Voice Integrity/CNAM trust product.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18609#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Please resubmit your registration using either an EIN or a DUN number.

# 18610: Customer Profile or Trust Product cannot be copied due to a deleted Address

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 18610

[error-18610 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18610#error-18610)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PHONE NUMBERS

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18610#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Customer Profile or Trust Product requested cannot be copied due to a deleted Address.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18610#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The Address linked to the Customer Profile or Trust Product was deleted.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/18610#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Create a new Address on your Account or Sub-Account (if you don't already have one) and reach out to [Twilio Support(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us "Twilio Support") to link it to the Customer Profile or Trust Product that you wish to copy.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

## ERROR: 19011

ERROR

* * *

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19011#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Invalid JSON or fields other than first\_name, middle\_name, last\_name, legal\_name, preferred\_name, unique\_customer\_provided\_id or custom\_fields exist in update contact request

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 19023

[error-19023 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19023#error-19023)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE MESSAGING

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19023#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Request with an invalid channel type

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19023#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- If you are sending rich content and are receiving this error when a message fallback is occurring, a content type that is not supported on the fallback message channel is being used.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19023#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- If you are sending rich content such as a card, ensure you also define a twilio/text translation for SMS fallback or twilio/media translation for MMS fallback.

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19036#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The page token provided in the request is not valid

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19036#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Page token provided is not an integer

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/19036#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Page token must be an integer

# 20003: Permission Denied

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 20003

[error-20003 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#error-20003)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

#### Authenticating requests to the Twilio API

[authenticating-requests-to-the-twilio-api page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#authenticating-requests-to-the-twilio-api)

All requests to sensitive areas of the Twilio API must use [HTTP Basic Authentication(link takes you to an external page)](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basic_access_authentication "HTTP Basic Authentication"). Authenticate using your Account SID as the username, and your Auth Token as the password. Both can be found in the [Twilio Console](https://www.twilio.com/console/account/settings "Twilio Console").

You can also generate revocable [API Keys](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/keys/api-key "API Keys") to authenticate.

You may want to consider using a [Twilio helper library](https://www.twilio.com/docs/libraries "Twilio helper library") (available in PHP, .NET, Java, Ruby, Python and Node.js) as they will take care of authentication for you.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Using the wrong combination of Account SID and Auth Token
- Using Test Credentials to access your Live Account
- Using subaccount credentials to access master account
- Previous Auth Token has been deleted
- Attempted API Key has been deleted
- Account is suspended or closed
- Extra characters or spaces in the supplied credentials
- Web proxy is stripping out credentials before forwarding to Twilio
- Using JWT with Auth Token rather than API Key
- Attempted API Key is for the incorrect Twilio Region

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20003#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Verify the Account SID and Auth Token are correct
- Verify the correct Account is being accessed
- Ensure the Account is active, not suspended or closed
- Ensure no extra characters or spaces are being included
- Ensure JWT is only used with API Key
- Ensure the API Key's Twilio Region matches the request's specified Twilio Region

#### Cannot access this resource with Test Credentials

[cannot-access-this-resource-with-test-credentials page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/20008#cannot-access-this-resource-with-test-credentials)

Currently only a handful of API resources can be tested with your test credentials. Trying to authenticate with your test credentials to other resources will return a Forbidden error message. # 21212: Invalid 'From' Number

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 21212

[error-21212 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21212#error-21212)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21212#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You attempted to initiate an outbound phone call or message, but the `From` parameter you supplied was not a valid phone number, Alphanumeric Sender ID or approved WhatsApp Sender.

Twilio accepts phone numbers in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format") (i.e. "+1 format"), 10-digit US and Canadian numbers with any combination of non-digit separators, or Alphanumeric Sender IDs (SMS only) with up to 11 alphanumeric characters \[a-zA-Z0-9\]. Refer to [this page(link takes you to an external page)](https://support.twilio.com/hc/en-us/articles/223133867-Using-Alphanumeric-Sender-ID-with-Messaging-Services "this page") for acceptable characters.

The number must not be on a do-not-originate (DNO) list, and Alphanumeric Sender IDs may not be generic.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21212#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- You have supplied a phone number that was not in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format").
- Your `From` phone number is on a do-not-originate (DNO) list.
- Your [Alphanumeric Sender ID](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-alphanumeric-sender-id "Alphanumeric Sender ID") is blocked or too generic.
- You are trying to use an Alphanumeric Sender ID on Trial Account. Trial accounts [cannot send from Alphanumeric Sender IDs](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/guides/how-to-use-your-free-trial-account#sending-sms-and-mms-messages "cannot send from Alphanumeric Sender IDs").
- Your WhatsApp Sender is not approved.
- You attempted to send a message with a `From` number that has an invalid prefix, using a Messaging Service.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21212#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Ensure your number is formatted in [E.164 format](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164 "E.164 format").
- Ensure that your `From` number is assigned and not on a do-not-originate (DNO) list.
- Ensure you are not using an [alphanumeric sender ID](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-alphanumeric-sender-id "alphanumeric sender ID") that is too generic (for example, "SMS" or "INFO").
- If you are getting this error when using a non-generic alphanumeric sender ID, please [submit a support ticket(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/console/support/tickets/create "submit a support ticket") for further assistance.
- If you are using an Alphanumeric Sender ID on a Trial Account, upgrade your account.
- If you are using a WhatsApp Sender, check that your [sender is approved(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/us1/develop/sms/senders/whatsapp-senders "sender is approved") and that you have followed the [onboarding instructions](https://www.twilio.com/docs/whatsapp/tutorial/requesting-access-to-whatsapp "onboarding instructions").
- If you are sending messages using a Messaging Service, and you wish to utilize an RCS Agent in your Sender Pool that falls back to SMS, [send the message from a MessagingServiceSid](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/services#send-a-message-with-a-messaging-service-1 "send the message from a MessagingServiceSid").

# 30909: Campaign vetting rejection - Message Flow / Call to Action Incomplete or Verification Issue

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

* * *

## ERROR: 30909

[error-30909 page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30909#error-30909)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

PROGRAMMABLE MESSAGING

ERROR

* * *

## Description

[description page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30909#description)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio returns this error when an A2P 10DLC campaign registration is rejected due to issues verifying the Call to Action (CTA). The error page states the submission "was reviewed and rejected due to issues verifying the Call to Action (CTA) provided for the campaign," and notes that if opt‑in occurs outside a website, the information provided was incomplete or insufficiently detailed.

In Twilio's A2P registration flow, the CTA is captured in the "Message Flow/Call to Action" text where you must describe how end users give consent. Twilio's guidance explains this section's purpose and required disclosures, including brand identification, message frequency (for recurring programs), links to terms and privacy policy, "message and data rates may apply," and opt‑out instructions.

### Possible Causes

[possible-causes page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30909#possible-causes)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- The CTA (Message Flow) does not clearly explain how users opt in, or lacks sufficient detail to verify off‑website consent flows (for example, in‑store, verbal, or paper).
- The Message Flow omits one or more required elements such as brand identification, frequency disclosure (if recurring), links to terms and privacy policy, the "message and data rates may apply" disclosure, or opt‑out instructions.
- Not all opt‑in methods used by the campaign are listed in the Message Flow (for example, web form plus keyword plus in‑person), preventing reviewers from validating consent.
- The opt‑in evidence is not publicly accessible (for example, behind a login) and no hosted screenshots or equivalent proof were provided, so reviewers can't verify the CTA.

### Possible Solutions

[possible-solutions page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30909#possible-solutions)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- Rewrite the Message Flow to fully describe every way consent is collected (web, keyword/text‑in, verbal script, paper form, QR, etc.), then resubmit the campaign. Twilio confirms you should include all consent methods when opt‑in isn't solely on a website.
- Ensure the Message Flow includes required disclosures: brand identification, message frequency (for recurring programs), links to terms and a compliant privacy policy, "message and data rates may apply," and opt‑out instructions.
- If the web opt‑in or other required info isn't publicly accessible, add a public URL with hosted screenshots of the relevant pages to allow verification.
- If your app primarily "replies" to inbound messages (conversational use), explicitly document in the Message Flow how users initiate contact and consent (for example, "customers text our support number to start a conversation"), and include required disclosures and opt‑out instructions.
- When using keyword/text‑in opt‑in, include the keyword(s) and provide the required help/opt‑out responses (or use Twilio's defaults). Align your message samples and campaign description with the Message Flow.
- After updating the CTA information, resubmit the campaign for review. This is the prescribed next step on the error page.

* * *

[additional-resources page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/30909#additional-resources)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

# Send templates created with the Content Template Builder

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

This guide explains how to send messages using templates created with the Content Template Builder. You will learn how to configure the necessary fields in your API request and use Messaging Services to send content templates.

To send messages from templates created using the Content Template Builder, include two new fields in your API request. First, configure a [Messaging Service](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/services "Messaging Service") and [create your content template](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/create-templates-with-the-content-template-builder "create your content template").

* * *

## New content fields used to send messages

[new-content-fields-used-to-send-messages page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/send-templates-created-with-the-content-template-builder#new-content-fields-used-to-send-messages)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

You will use the existing messaging endpoint with an additional field, `ContentSid`. You may also include the `ContentVariables` field to substitute any placeholder values in your templates.

Copy code block

```

```

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ContentSid` | Yes | String field used to identify the preconfigured content. Required to send templates created using the Content Template Builder. |
| `ContentVariables` | No | JSON string used to define the values of any placeholder variables found in the preconfigured content. Key-value pairs of placeholder variable names and substitution values. Content templates support up to 100 key-value pairs per send request. |

(information)

## Info

If you are sending a WhatsApp message outside the 24-hour free-form session, you need to use a template approved by WhatsApp. To learn more, see [Content API quick start](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/create-and-send-your-first-content-api-template "Content API quick start").

# twilio/quick-reply

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

The `twilio/quick-reply` content type lets recipients tap, rather than type, to respond to a message. You can include up to ten quick-reply buttons. When you send an in-session WhatsApp message that does **not** require template approval, only three buttons are allowed.

(warning)

## Warning

`twilio/quick-reply` content templates can be sent over WhatsApp for out-of-session messages that include variables. If the template body starts or ends with a variable, or if two variables appear adjacent to each other, WhatsApp will reject the template. A sample value for each variable is required. For details, see [Using Variables with Content Templates](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/using-variables-with-content-api "Using Variables with Content Templates").

* * *

## Supported channels

[supported-channels page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/twilio-quick-reply#supported-channels)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- WhatsApp
- Facebook Messenger

* * *

## Message preview

# twilio/list-picker

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

The `twilio/list-picker` content type includes a menu of up to 10 options for users to make a selection.

(information)

## Info

List-picker templates are only available once the end user is in a 24 hour session. They can't initiate a [business initiated session](https://www.twilio.com/docs/content/session-definitions "business initiated session").

List-picker templates aren't supported for approval on WhatsApp and can't be submitted for approval.

# SDK Overview

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

Twilio provides a client-side SDK for browser-based development, as well as SDKs for native development on iOS and Android.

Our SDKs provide a convenient collection of objects, methods, and events to connect your client-side application to Conversations.

For the most up-to-date installation methods, version history, and documentation, check out:

- The [JavaScript](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-download-install#javascript-sdk "JavaScript"), [Android](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-download-install#android-sdk "Android"), or [iOS](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-download-install#ios-sdk "iOS") download page
- The [JavaScript](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/javascript/changelog "JavaScript"), [Android](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/android/changelog "Android"), or [iOS](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/ios/changelog "iOS") changelogs
- The [JavaScript(link takes you to an external page)](https://sdk.twilio.com/js/conversations/latest/docs "JavaScript"), [Android(link takes you to an external page)](https://sdk.twilio.com/android/conversations/latest/docs "Android"), or [iOS(link takes you to an external page)](https://sdk.twilio.com/ios/conversations/latest/docs "iOS") auto-generated documentation

* * *

## Initialization

[initialization page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-overview#initialization)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Initializing the Conversations SDKs is an important step to ensure your client is ready to use on an end user's mobile or web device.

To get started, you'll need to initialize a new `Client` object. You'll need to pass a valid [Access Token](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/create-tokens "Access Token") to the client creation method as the first parameter.

After that, you should listen for the client to inform you when it's fully initialized/synchronized.

Once you receive this confirmation, the client is ready to use.

Client Initialization [Link to code sample: Client Initialization](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-overview#code-client-initialization)

## Token Events

[token-events page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-overview#token-events)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

(information)

## Info

If the token expires before you renew it, the client's connection state will change to disconnected, and you'll need to initialize a new client object.

All tokens have a limited lifetime to protect you from abuse. The maximum and default lifetime is 24 hours, but you should make it as short as possible for your application. Therefore, you may need to renew the token during your SDK session. The SDK will notify you when the token is " _about to expire"_ and when it " _has expired"_.

To avoid needing to instantiate a new client, you should get a new token from your server and pass it to the client's `updateToken` method before the old one expires. This method will update the authentication token for your client and re-register with the Conversations services.

Token Events [Link to code sample: Token Events](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-overview#code-token-events)

Node.jsTypescript

## Client Connection State

[client-connection-state page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-overview#client-connection-state)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

(information)

## Info

There is a reconnection attempt period when the network connectivity is lost before the client switches to the disconnected state.

During use, the connection state of your SDK client may change.

These are the possible client connection states:

- `connecting`\- the client is offline and a connection attempt is in progress
- `connected` \- the client is online and ready
- `disconnecting` \- the client is going offline as disconnection is in progress
- `disconnected` \- the client is offline and no connection attempt is in progress
- `denied` \- the client connection is denied because of an invalid JSON Web Token access token. The user must refresh the token in order to proceed

The above-mentioned states are also documented in our SDK reference docs.

The client state changes are due to different factors. For instance, let's take the `disconnected` state as an example. This could happen due to a network disruption, expired token, or other error. You can listen to the client's connection state events to detect this and respond accordingly.

Handling Client State [Link to code sample: Handling Client State](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations/sdk-overview#code-handling-client-state)

# What is an SMS API?

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

A _SMS API_ is well-defined software interface which enables code to send short messages via a SMS Gateway.

As the infrastructures for SMS communications and the internet are mostly divided, SMS APIs are often used to 'bridge the gap' between telecommunications carrier networks and the wider web. SMS APIs are used to allow web applications to send and receive text messages through logic written for standard web frameworks.

* * *

## Quickly integrate an SMS API with your business

[quickly-integrate-an-sms-api-with-your-business page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-is-sms-api-short-messaging-service#quickly-integrate-an-sms-api-with-your-business)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

As the number of developers with web experience outnumbers developers with a telecommunications focus, there is a huge demand for SMS APIs and Communications APIs that allow productivity from both worlds. Twilio's [Programmable Messaging(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/messaging/channels/sms "Programmable Messaging") product offers a stable [RESTful API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api "RESTful API") and powerful features that bring telecommunications programming to the web domain.

# Access Tokens

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

Access Tokens are short-lived tokens that you use to authenticate Twilio client-side SDKs like [Voice](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/sdks "Voice"), [Conversations](https://www.twilio.com/docs/conversations "Conversations"), [Sync](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sync/sync-sdk-download "Sync"), and [Video](https://www.twilio.com/docs/video/platform-sdk-support-policy "Video").

You create them on your server to verify a user's identity and grant access to client API features. All tokens have a limited lifetime, configurable for up to 24 hours. However, a best practice is to generate Access Tokens for the shortest amount of time feasible for your application.

* * *

## Contents

[contents page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#contents)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

- [Anatomy of an Access Token](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#token-anatomy "Anatomy of an Access Token")
- [How to create Access Tokens](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#creating-tokens "How to create Access Tokens")
  - [Conversations](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#create-an-access-token-for-conversations "Conversations")
  - [Voice](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#create-an-access-token-for-voice "Voice")
  - [Video](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#create-an-access-token-for-video "Video")
  - [Sync](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#create-an-access-token-for-sync "Sync")
- [Managing Access Token lifecycle](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#managing-lifecycle "Managing Access Token lifecycle")

* * *

## Anatomy of an Access Token

[token-anatomy page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#token-anatomy)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Each Access Token is a [JSON Web Token(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "JSON Web Token") (JWT), an encoded JSON object with three parts: the header, the payload, and the signature. The following is an example Access Token generated for Conversations.

Copy code block

```

```

If you inspect it [with the debugger at jwt.io(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "with the debugger at jwt.io"), you can further explore its content.

### Header

[jwt-header page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#jwt-header)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Copy code block

```

```

The `header` section encodes the format of the token:

- `typ` is the type of token. Its value **must** be `"JWT"`.
- `alg` is the algorithm used to encode the token. Its value **must** be `"HS256"`.
- `cty` is the content type and encodes the version of the Access Token. Its value **must** be `"twilio-fpa;v=1"`.

### Payload

[payload page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#payload)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Copy code block

```

```

The `payload` section describes the authorization granted:

- `jti` is a unique identifier for the token. Your application can choose this identifier. The default SDK implementation includes the SID of the API key used to generate the token and a unique random string.
- `iss` is the issuer — the API key containing the secret used to sign the token.
- `sub` is the SID of the Twilio Account to which access is scoped.
- `iat` is the timestamp at which the token was issued.
- `nbf` is an optional timestamp, before which the token will NOT be accepted.
- `exp` is the timestamp at which the token will expire. Tokens have a maximum age of 24 hours.
- `grants` is the list of permissions that the token grants. Grant properties and values will depend on the Twilio product and the needs of your specific use case.

### Signature

[signature page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#signature)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

The `signature` section is a signed hash that serves to prove the authenticity of the token. It is the result of hashing the JWT header and payload together with your API key secret, which should only be known to your application and Twilio.

* * *

## Create Access Tokens

[creating-tokens page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#creating-tokens)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Twilio Access Tokens are based on the [JSON Web Token(link takes you to an external page)](https://jwt.io/ "JSON Web Token") standard.

You can use one of Twilio's SDKs to create Access Tokens quickly and programmatically.

### Step 1: Find your Account SID

[step-1-account-sid page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#step-1-account-sid)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Every Access Token requires your Account SID, which you can find in your [Twilio Console(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/ "Twilio Console"). This is how the AccessToken will tie a user's activity to a specific Twilio account.

### Step 2: Create an API Key and Secret

[step-2-api-key page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#step-2-api-key)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Next, you need to create an [API key](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/key-resource-v2010 "API key"). You can create API keys from the [Twilio Console(link takes you to an external page)](https://console.twilio.com/us1/account/keys-credentials/api-keys?frameUrl=/console/project/api-keys "Twilio Console") or with the [REST API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/key-resource-v2010 "REST API").

**Note:** You can create Access Tokens using **Main** and **Standard** API Keys. Creating Access Tokens is not yet supported with Restricted API Keys.

(warning)

## Warning

If you are creating a key to use with Twilio Video, you must create it in the **US1** Region. [Learn more in the Twilio Video documentation.](https://www.twilio.com/docs/video/tutorials/user-identity-access-tokens#api-key-region "Learn more in the Twilio Video documentation.")

When you create the API key, you'll be shown the key's secret, which is used to sign the Access Token. For security, you will only be shown the secret at this time, so you need to store it with the key's SID in a secure location for the next step.

### Step 3: Generate an Access Token

[step-3-generate-token page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens#step-3-generate-token)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Now use the information gathered in steps 1 and 2 to generate an Access Token using a Twilio SDK.

When creating an Access Token, you must provide:

- Your Twilio Account SID
- The API key SID and API key secret from Step 2

You can also optionally provide any of the following JWT configuration values.

| Parameter | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | The identity to associate with the Access Token. Typically, this will be a username in your system. Voice tokens may only contain alpha-numeric and underscore characters. | `user_name` |
| `ttl` | Time to live for the token, in seconds. | `3600` |
| `nbf` | Token not before time, or the time before which the token will NOT be accepted. Values are in Epoch time. | `1615404972` |
| `region` | The intended [Twilio Region](https://www.twilio.com/docs/global-infrastructure/understanding-twilio-regions "Twilio Region") for the token. Currently only supported for Voice tokens. | `us1` |

Each Twilio product will also require at least one "grant", which will provide product-specific abilities to the user associated with an Access Token.

(warning)

## Warning

Programmable Voice access tokens limit the number of concurrent sessions for a given identity to ten. When the 11th instance of the identity is registered the oldest registration is removed.

The Voice SDKs require each Access Token to contain an `identity` grant and a `VoiceGrant`. The `identity` grant is what associates an Access Token with a specific user.

Each `VoiceGrant` contains the following parameters:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

| outgoingApplicationSid | string | The SID of the TwiML App that Twilio will look to when making outgoing calls. (Note: This is **required** for using any of the Voice SDKs.) |
| outgoingApplicationParams | object | Request parameters to send to the TwiML Application for outgoing calls |
| pushCredentialSid | string | The SID of the Push Credential to use when registering to receive incoming call notifications ( **Mobile SDKs only**) |

#### Create an Access Token for Video

## Warning

The API Key you use to create an Access Token for Twilio Video [must be in the US1 region](https://www.twilio.com/docs/video/tutorials/user-identity-access-tokens#api-key-region "must be in the US1 region").

The Video SDKs require each Access Token to contain an `identity` grant and a `VideoGrant`.

The `identity` grant is what associates an Access Token with a specific user.

Each `VideoGrant` contains an optional `room` parameter for a specific Room name or SID, which indicates the holder of the Access Token may only connect to the indicated Room.

# Our API: the basics

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

The Twilio REST API allows you to query metadata about your [account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account "account"), [phone numbers](https://www.twilio.com/docs/phone-numbers/api/availablephonenumber-resource "phone numbers"), calls, text messages, and recordings. You can also do some fancy things like [initiate outbound calls](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/make-calls "initiate outbound calls") and [send text messages](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging "send text messages").

* * *

## Base URL

[base-url page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api#base-url)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

All URLs referenced in the documentation have the following base:

Copy code block

```

```

The Twilio REST API is served over HTTPS. To ensure data privacy, unencrypted HTTP is not supported.

* * *

## Authentication

[authentication page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api#authentication)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, Twilio supports [HTTP Basic authentication(link takes you to an external page)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basic_access_authentication "HTTP Basic authentication"). Use your _API key_ as the username and your _API key secret_ as the password. You can create an API key either [in the Twilio Console](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/keys-in-console "in the Twilio Console") or [using the API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/key-resource-v1 "using the API").

**Note**: Twilio recommends using API keys for authentication in production apps. For local testing, you can use your Account SID as the username and your Auth token as the password. You can find your Account SID and Auth Token in the [Twilio Console(link takes you to an external page)](https://www.twilio.com/console "Twilio Console").

Learn more about [Twilio API authentication](https://www.twilio.com/docs/usage/requests-to-twilio "Twilio API authentication").

# REST API: Accounts

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

* * *

When you first sign up with Twilio, you have just one account, your main account. But you can also create more accounts.
Subaccounts are useful for things like segmenting phone numbers and usage data for
your customers and controlling access to data. For more information on subaccounts, see [Using Subaccounts](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/subaccounts "Using Subaccounts").

* * *

## Account Properties

[account-properties page anchor](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account#account-properties)

Positive FeedbackNegative Feedback

Property nameTypeRequiredDescriptionChild properties

authTokenstring

Optional

[PII MTL: 30 days](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-is-personally-identifiable-information-pii#pii-fields)

The authorization token for this account. This token should be kept a secret, so no sharing.

Optional

Optional

[PII MTL: 30 days](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-is-personally-identifiable-information-pii#pii-fields)
